name: Hengbo Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hengbo Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of internal combustion engine intake systems and accessories; and HEV intake systems in China and internationally. It also involved in fuel evaporation systems; new energy vehicle thermal management systems; interior systems; hydrogen fuel cell cathode filtration systems; motorcycle intelligent instruments, and lightweight, high-performance precision components. The company also provides thermal management, cabin air management system for new energy vehicles; hydrogen fuel cell system; air purification and disinfection products.
